decision_conditions: <p>By reasons of its excessive depth and limited width of the extension, the two storey rear extension would appear disproportionate in bulk and would result in an awkward appearance to the dwelling that would be considered out of character with the existing dwelling, contrary to policies D3.D(11) and D4 of the London Plan (2021) and GR1A and GR1B.a of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-41) and the Residential Design Guide Supplementary Planning Document (2010).&nbsp;</p>

<p>By reasons of the depth, size and bulk of both the part single storey and part two storey rear extensions, the proposed development would result in an adverse overbearing impact and sense of enclosure for the neighbouring occupiers at No. 34 Honister Gardens, contrary to policies D3.D(7) of the London Plan (2021), Policy GR1C and Strategic Policy 01 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021) and the Residential Design Guide Supplementary Planning Document (2010).</p>

<p>Insufficient information has been submitted to demonstrate that the proposed development which would encroach into the rear garden that is part of the Green Chain Corridor and the Rattler including Belmont Nature Walk Sites of Importance for Nature Conservation (SINC) and would preserve and cause no damage to the ecology and the protected species, contrary to policies G6A and C of the London Plan (2021) and policy GI3F(a) and strategic policy 07D of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</p>

<p>Insufficient information has been submitted to demonstrate that there would be no adverse impact on existing protected trees and landscaping features within a Green Chain Corridor and the Sites of Importance for Nature Conservation. The proposal would be contrary to Policies G7 of the London Plan (2021) and Policies GI4 and Strategic Policy 07H of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-41).</p>

<p>The proposal would encroach into the land that form part of a Designated Open Space that would not be ancillary to the use of the open space and no information has been provided to demonstrate that the loss of the open space would be surplus to requirements or be replaced by equivalent or better provision. The proposal would be contrary to policies G4B1) of the London Plan (2021) and policies GI2A and C and strategic policy 07A, B and C of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).&nbsp;</p>

<p>Insufficient information has been provided in the Flood Risk Assessment submitted to demonstrate that the proposed development would have no adverse increase in fluvial flood risk of the site, contrary to policies SI 12 and SI 13 of the London Plan (2021) and policies CN3 and CN4 and strategic policy 07 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</p>
description: Single and two storey rear extension,  Alterations to roof to form rear dormer, Decking to rear
